children: Combining entertainment collectibles with preservation and authentication technology, Alliance Authentic continues to connect with collectors through exclusive releases and fan experiences

, a scaled entertainment commerce and collectibles platform serving content owners, brands, retailers and fans across music, movies, gaming, licensed merchandise and collectibles, with proprietary brands, authentication technology and reach across more than 35,000 retail and e-commerce storefronts, today announced that its Alliance Authentic division will showcase an exclusive collection of Danny Elfman signed collectibles, alongside preserved vinyl records and collectible figures, at L.A. Comic Con, taking place October 30 through November 1 at the Los Angeles Convention Center.

At Alliance Authentic’s booth (#1354), collectors will find something they cannot get anywhere else: five Danny Elfman signed pieces exclusively for Alliance Authentic, including The Simpsons Main Title Theme on 10-inch vinyl, The Nightmare Before Christmas, Beetlejuice and Justice League on LP, plus a Jack Skellington figure from Handmade By Robots. Each piece is limited to just five, and every signature is authenticated. The signed pieces are available only at L.A. Comic Con, with any remaining pieces offered to collectors registered with Alliance Authentic after the show.

The brand made its Comic Con debut in San Diego this summer, where Nerd News Social called it "the collecting platform for a new generation," and appeared at New York Comic Con earlier this month, where Temple of Geek said Alliance Authentic "takes vinyl collecting to a new level."

The booth will also carry more than 65 preserved vinyl soundtracks across film, TV, anime and games, from Spirited Away and KPop Demon Hunters to Scream, Ghostbusters, Star Wars, Harry Potter, The Lord of the Rings and more, plus preserved Funko Pop! and Handmade By Robots figures. Fans can step inside a nine-foot Alliance Authentic collectible box for a photo, and collectors with a registered Alliance Authentic account who take one get a free Handmade By Robots Scooby-Doo micro figure, while supplies last. Everything at the booth, including the signed Elfman pieces, is available first come, first served.

Alliance Authentic preserves the pieces fans care about most. Every piece at the booth, the signed Elfman pieces included, is curated, numbered, limited and sealed in Certified Uncirculated condition, so none ever reached a retail shelf. An NFC chip gives each piece a verified identity. Collectors tap the chip to confirm it, claim it, and keep its full history with it if it ever changes hands.
"We're so excited to bring the full Alliance Authentic experience to the fan community at L.A. Comic Con,
" said Jeffrey Smith, SVP of Marketing at Alliance Authentic. "

Danny Elfman signatures on some of the most important work of his career, the week of Halloween? That's incredibly special. If you love horror, sci-fi or anime, we preserved some of the coolest pieces out there for you. I can't wait to see everyone at the booth."

Alliance Authentic preserves the records, figures, and films fans care about most. Every preserved piece meets five standards: Curated, Numbered, Limited, Certified Uncirculated and NFC-Secured. Each carries a verified identity and provenance that travels with it to every future collector. Alliance Authentic is home to The Ultimate Vinyl Collectible™ and works with partners including Handmade By Robots and Funko. Alliance Authentic is a division of Alliance Entertainment

is a premier distributor and fulfillment partner for the entertainment and pop culture collectibles industry. With more than 340,000 unique in-stock SKUs - including over 57,300 exclusive titles across compact discs, vinyl LPs, DVDs, Blu-rays, and video games - Alliance offers the largest selection of physical media in the market. Our vast catalog also includes licensed merchandise, toys, retro gaming products, and collectibles, serving over 35,000 retail locations and powering e-commerce fulfillment for leading retailers. Alliance also owns and operates proprietary collectibles brands, including Handmade by Robots™, a stylized vinyl figure line featuring licensed characters from leading entertainment franchises, and Alliance Authentic™, a premium platform for authentic, certified, and individually numbered entertainment collectibles. In addition, Alliance operates Endstate Authentic, a dedicated NFC-enabled authentication and digital product identity platform supporting authenticated collectibles, resale, and brand protection. Leveraging decades of operational expertise, exclusive sourcing relationships, and a capital-light, scalable infrastructure, Alliance connects fans and collectors to the products, franchises, and experiences they value across formats and generations.
